description: Benchmark test cases for OPEA agent evaluation

categories.RAG only: Queries that should trigger only the rag_retrieve tool
categories.Simulation only: Queries that should trigger only the run_simulation tool
categories.Both tools: Complex diagnostic queries requiring both tools in sequence

test_cases.query: What does 3GPP specify about PDSCH scheduling in 5G NR?
Explain the O-RAN Non-RT RIC A1 interface and its role in policy management.
Run a baseline simulation with 20 UEs on cell 0 and report the KPIs.
Run a high interference scenario with 30 UEs and tell me the SINR and packet loss.
Cell 7 is showing 40% throughput degradation. Run a simulation to diagnose and explain what the standards say about this condition.
There are 45 handovers per minute on cell 3. Is this abnormal? Simulate handover stress and check what O-RAN recommends.
Compare high_load and baseline scenarios for 50 UEs, and cite the 3GPP capacity planning guidelines.
